terms.comment: To go to a funeral, in fūnus venīre (Cic. Att. 15.1b.1, Lewis & Short; Traupman 170).
Prudentius’s burial hymn is the Hymnus circā exequiās dēfūnctī (Cath. 10).

phrases.latin: fūnus interim prōcēdit: sequimur; ad sepulcrum venīmus; in ignem inpositast; flētur.
phrases.english: Meanwhile the funeral moves off; we follow; we come to the tomb; she is laid on the pyre; there is weeping.

sources: Lewis & Short: funus · Lewis & Short: exsequiae · Lewis & Short: sepultura
